blocking_findings.title: Prestage auditor independence is chronologically unsatisfiable and lacks a typed identity binding
blocking_findings.evidence: Order is audit, Root activation, then role freeze, but audit PASS must distinguish its actor from future unassigned actors. The audit binds only auditor_actor_id while the freeze later claims actor, session, process-principal, delegation, public-attestation and provenance distinctions. Repair: bind the auditor's complete identity/provenance tuple at audit time; compare Root at activation; later verify exact auditor-to-18 joins.

blocking_findings.title: The 153 conflict rows are not schema-joined to the 18 frozen assignments
blocking_findings.evidence: Conflict-row role and actor IDs are merely nonempty; count/order does not require indexed role pairs, actor equality to assignments, or a unique pair key. Other identity dimensions are bare booleans. Repair: require exact indexed roles, actor-to-assignment equality, unique pairs, typed identities, all 153 joins and 18 auditor comparisons.

blocking_findings.title: CreateProcess crash uncertainty cannot be truthfully represented
blocking_findings.evidence: A crash during or just after CreateProcessW leaves identical bytes for never-started versus started-before-staging, but the incident schema requires a Boolean and a favorable trigger choice. Repair: freeze NOT_STARTED_PROVEN, STARTED_PROVEN or UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT, or an equivalent durable protocol; UNKNOWN is always spent and incident-contained.

blocking_findings.title: The terminal state machine and incident routing are incomplete and overlapping
blocking_findings.evidence: Claimed-before-handoff and terminal-renamed-before-attestation checkpoints lack states; INTERRUPTED_SPENT overlaps ordinary states; P1-P5 failures lack an exhaustive exact trigger map despite implicit normalization being forbidden. Repair: define disjoint observable checkpoint states and an ordered total failure/interruption-to-trigger/state table.

blocking_findings.title: Root lacks staging content-read authority required by terminal validation
blocking_findings.evidence: P2S/P2F require parsing staged artifact and receipts before publication/quarantine, but Root reads include final committed/failed members, not staged files; metadata permission expressly is not content read. Repair: add exact selected-branch staging read_path_ids, bind them in authorization/attestation, and deny unselected-branch reads.

blocking_findings.title: Composite materialized-schema projections and hash domains are undefined
blocking_findings.evidence: The eight-schema Root file has no exact projection container/pointer list or same-path byte equality; the literal-audit specialization lies outside its source hash domain. source_json_pointer is untyped text and byte equality is asserted, not derived. Repair: freeze one typed source projection per physical file, all source pointers including specialization, canonical byte/hash equations, and same-path membership semantics.

blocking_findings.title: Mandatory FlushFileBuffers publication is unreachable with the frozen handle access
blocking_findings.evidence: V4 grants attribute-only directory handles but requires FlushFileBuffers SUCCESS_DURABLE; that API requires GENERIC_WRITE. Repair: freeze CreateFileW DesiredAccess including GENERIC_WRITE and attest its mask, while separately prohibiting mutation calls, or freeze another durability API with matching access requirements.
